title: Optimal Linear Regression Without a Variance
abstract:
arXiv:2611.27983v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study high-probability linear regression in the infinite variance regime, wherecthe regression noise has only a finite conditional $\alpha$-moment $
u$ for some unknown $\alpha\in(1,2)$, and the covariates may only have finite moments up to a given order (e.g., 4th moment). We give a black-box reduction that converts finite-variance regression procedures into weak-moment procedures. The reduction is based on empirical residual pruning and is agnostic to the moment exponent, the noise scale, the covariance, and the design moment. Under a finite fourth-moment condition on the covariates, any finite-variance subroutine attaining the sub-Gaussian rate yields the following when the number of samples $n$ is above a suitably defined threshold: Without knowing $\alpha$ or $
u$, we have with probability at least $1-\delta$ that $ \|\widehat	heta-	heta^*\|_\Sigma   \lesssim_\alpha   
u^{1/\alpha}    ig( rac{d+\log(1/\delta)}{n} ig)^{\

translated_title: 无需方差假设的最优线性回归
translated_abstract: 我们研究了无穷方差情形下的高概率线性回归问题，其中回归噪声仅对某个未知的 α∈(1,2) 具有有限的条件 α-矩 ν，而协变量可能只具有直至给定阶数的有限矩（例如4阶矩）。我们提出了一种黑盒归约方法，能够将有限方差的回归程序转换为弱矩条件下的回归程序。该归约基于经验残差剪枝，并且对矩指数、噪声尺度、协方差以及设计矩都是不可知的（即无需预先知道这些量）。在协变量满足有限四阶矩的条件下，任何达到亚高斯速率的有限方差子程序，当样本数 n 超过某个适当定义的阈值时，均可得到如下结果：在不知道 α 或 ν 的情况下，我们以至少 1−δ 的概率有 ‖θ̂−θ*‖_Σ ≲_α ν^{1/α} ((d+log(1/δ))/n)^{…
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于经验残差剪枝的黑盒归约方法，在噪声仅有未知有限α矩（α∈(1,2)）且协变量仅有有限四阶矩的无穷方差情形下，可将任意有限方差回归算法自动转化为达到最优统计速率的弱矩回归算法，且无需知道矩指数、噪声尺度等任何先验信息。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a black-box reduction based on empirical residual pruning that converts any finite-variance regression procedure into an optimal-rate weak-moment procedure in the infinite-variance regime, agnostic to the unknown moment exponent, noise scale, covariance, and design moments.
